overview.label: Overview
overview.help: What this campaign sends, to whom and when. Click a line to change it.

opener.label: First message
opener.help: The first message every lead gets, and how it introduces the assistant.

followups.label: Follow-ups
followups.help: The nudges a lead gets when they do not reply.

behaviour.label: Behaviour
behaviour.help: Who the assistant is and how it writes once a lead replies.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.help: The conversation prompt this campaign runs.

knowledge.label: Knowledge
knowledge.help: What the assistant knows about the business and about these leads.

sending.label: Channel & schedule
sending.help: WhatsApp or SMS, and when and how fast messages go out.

advanced.label: Advanced
advanced.help: Engine settings for the agency. Most campaigns never need these.

overview.title: This campaign at a glance
overview.windowValue: {{start}} to {{end}}, up to {{limit}} new leads a day

opener.messageHelp: Click the preview to edit. Words in braces such as {first_name} are filled in per lead. The template button offers ready-made openers.
opener.label: Message
opener.voiceNote: Send it as a voice note
opener.voiceNoteHelp: On WhatsApp the first message goes out as a spoken voice note. Needs voice replies switched on under Behaviour.
opener.optOutHelp: Adds a short "reply STOP to stop" line under the first message. Expected for SMS in the US.

followups.countHelp: Each follow-up goes out only if the lead has not replied yet. When the last one gets no answer, the lead is marked lost.
followups.messagePlaceholder: What this follow-up says. Left empty, this follow-up is skipped.
followups.anglePlaceholder: e.g. Mention that the spring schedule is filling up. Leave empty for the default.
followups.aiBumps: Let the AI write the follow-ups
followups.aiBumpsHelp: For leads who already replied, the AI writes each follow-up from the conversation and the angle given. Leads who never replied get the message text.
followups.stopOnResponse: Stop following up once the lead replies
followups.stopOnResponseHelp: Recommended. When off, the follow-ups keep their schedule even after a reply.
followups.laterTitle: When a lead asks to be contacted later
followups.laterHelp: Sent on the day the lead asked for ("try me again in March"). The AI writes it from the conversation; this text is the backup when it cannot.
followups.laterPlaceholder: Hi {first_name}, you asked me to get back to you around now...

behaviour.agentNameHelp: The first name the assistant signs with.
behaviour.languageHelp: The language the messages go out in.
behaviour.toneHelp: How it writes, in your own words.
behaviour.tonePlaceholder: e.g. Warm and brief, like a colleague who remembers them.
behaviour.repliesHelp: Up to how many short messages it may send in a row, like a person typing.
behaviour.voiceHelp: Whether it may answer with voice notes on WhatsApp.
behaviour.objectionsHelp: Answers you approved for the pushback these leads give most. The assistant uses them in its own words.

knowledge.companyHelp: How the assistant names the business in messages.
knowledge.descriptionHelp: A few lines the assistant can rely on.
knowledge.serviceHelp: What these leads once asked about.
knowledge.kbHelp: Prices, areas, opening hours, FAQs: anything the assistant may need to answer.
knowledge.accountKb: Also use the account's Company Intel
knowledge.accountKbHelp: Adds the knowledge saved for the whole account (shared with the receptionist).
knowledge.bookingLinkHelp: Where a lead books. Each lead gets their own short link to it.
knowledge.leadContext: What the assistant knows about them
knowledge.leadContextHelp: e.g. They asked for a quote last year and never booked. A per-lead note on the lead overrides this.
knowledge.whatLeadDidHelp: Their last step with the business.
knowledge.whenHelp: Roughly when that was, e.g. last spring.

sending.channelHelp: How the messages reach the leads. Replies come back on the same channel and the assistant answers them.

whatsapp_sms.label: WhatsApp, SMS as fallback
whatsapp_sms.help: Sends on WhatsApp. When a number is not on WhatsApp, or WhatsApp refuses a message, it goes out as an SMS instead.

whatsapp.label: WhatsApp only
whatsapp.help: Never sends an SMS. Leads who are not on WhatsApp are not reached.

sms.label: SMS
sms.help: Text messages only, for markets where SMS is the norm such as the US.

sending.smsNote: SMS goes out from the account's Twilio number. In the US that number must be registered for business texting (A2P 10DLC) first.
sending.template: Approved template for the first message
sending.templateHelp: WhatsApp only lets a business start a chat with an approved template. Without one, the first message goes out as an SMS (with SMS fallback) or is not sent (WhatsApp only).
sending.vcardHelp: The name on the contact card the lead can save. Empty uses the assistant and business name.
sending.hoursHelp: Messages only go out between these times.
sending.dailyLimitHelp: How many leads get their first message per day.
sending.intervalHelp: Spreads the sending out so it looks natural and protects the number.

advanced.roleHelp: One line on the assistant's job, used in the prompt.
advanced.conversationModeHelp: Scoping asks what the lead needs. Decision follows up on a quote they already have. Auto picks per lead.
advanced.bookingModeHelp: Book a sales call, or book the job directly.
advanced.typosHelp: A few small typos make the messages read human.
advanced.textDelayHelp: Seconds the assistant waits for more messages before it answers.
advanced.voiceDelayHelp: The same, after a voice note.
advanced.abHelp: Splits the leads between prompt A and prompt B.
advanced.legacyHelp: Older fields some prompts still read as {variables}. Leave them empty unless the prompt uses them.
advanced.nicheHelp: Picks the trade words such as {project}.
